findings.title: Distinctness depended on canonicalProductName/displayName/title instead of product identity
findings.baselineReproduction: Two candidates sharing canonicalProductUrl with different ad titles returned distinctCount=2 and isDistinct=true in evaluateShortlistDistinctness()

findings.title: Identity returned VERIFIED even when merchant metadata failed (403/404/timeout) or raw headline was 'Facebook Ad: 123...'
findings.baselineReproduction: resolveProductIdentity() treated /products/<handle> + rawHeadlines.length > 0 as independent corroboration, returning VERIFIED on HTTP 403 or 'Facebook Ad: 123...'

findings.title: Merchant metadata extracted SKU/GTIN/model/variantId from JSON-LD, but identity resolver returned sku: null
findings.baselineReproduction: fetchVerifiedProductPageMetadata() parsed JSON-LD sku, but resolveProductIdentity() hardcoded sku: null in the verified merchant branch

findings.title: Adaptive Round 2 recovery decided before post-gate identity/reality/distinctness filtering
findings.baselineReproduction: Round 2 decision checked preliminary discoveredCandidates count before metadata/AI/reality/distinctness gates reduced qualified products below 3

findings.title: Candidates truncated via slice(0, maxCandidates) before verification without refilling from unverified queue
findings.baselineReproduction: enrichProductCandidatesWithEvidence() sliced the top maxCandidates upfront and discarded remaining candidates even when top candidates failed verification or merged

findings.title: Google Ads Transparency connected with 0 product matches or brand-only ads needed strict state separation
findings.baselineReproduction: Google enrichment lacked granular stateBreakdown separating transportConnected, adsRetrieved, brandAssociatedCount, and productAssociatedEvidence

findings.title: Kitchen 3/3 shortlist contained three oil dispensers without product family clustering or diversity audit
findings.baselineReproduction: KITCHEN_US_30D_REAL_RUN.json returned 3 oil spray/dispenser listings without reporting that all 3 belong to 1 homogeneous product family (OIL_DISPENSER_SPRAYER)

findings.title: Acceptance L05 aggregation omitted Kitchen/Cleaning runs and recorded parent commit SHA
findings.baselineReproduction: runAcceptanceV12_4_2.ts computed maxLiveShortlistQualified over only 4 of 6 niches and wrote artifacts before final commit
